The Sentinels, Parse, Wraith & Omnitron-X, in the Tomb of Anubis : victory.

Expatriette and co having not found Christopher in Rook CIty (see above), she asked for the Wraith's help in uncovering clues on the pirate's whereabouts.

Maïa called for the help of Parse, Omnitron-X and the Sentinels, old ennemies of the pirate. Thanks to Parse analysis of the few clues found before, the team understood that the pirate was trying to use Christopher to bargain with Anubis, and gain lots of loot ! It was a hard fight. Lots of traps and of crew members fell on our heroes. In a few turns, both Parse and the Wraith were incapacitated, and Dr Medico & his pupil the Idealist were next ! All seemed lost.

But then la Capitan called for the Epeiste - it was a mistake, as Wrythe used his invention to redirect his heavy damage to la Capitan. With the help of Wraith's gadgets (her incapacitated side), the Sentinels slowly came back to force, bringing back the Idealist and Medico, while Omnitron-X managed to bring a lot of his tools out. Also, Anubis finally came to the heroes' help.

Finally - and it was a surprise - the surviving members of the team, with the help of lots of traps and mummies, and a little luck, forced the time travelling corsair to flee. Alas, she took Christopher with her.

Will Anubis give them the clues they need to finally free the Christopher at the Center ??? The answer in our next issue ! (maybe ?)

posts.name: christian.ian.cruze
posts.cooked:
Well, America's Greatest Legacy heard reports in his time zone of a sighting of a massive ship that "appeared out of nowhere" inside the Enclave of the Endlings.  AG Legacy contacted some heroes from the future for back up to try and locate our beloved Christopher.  Sky-Scraper, Tempest, and Parse, back from fighting a nasty fight in Warfang's Arena, answered the call.

With Sky-Scraper switching to her Huge form early and AG Legacy inspiring everyone with his presence, the heroes had no trouble dealing with La Capitan's crew.  During the last few turns of the fight, AG Legacy could have sworn he saw a man that looked like Christopher.  However, the environment kept getting in the way!  First, the Enclave releases Immutus, which seemed to protect La Capitan for a few turns--fortunately Sky-Scraper was ready to blow Immutus up with her Emergency Evac.

Again, AG Legacy was ready to finish La Capitan off (he was pretty sure she could have only had a little bit of health left...) and charge, motivationally of course, towards the man who looked like Christopher.  However, the environment retaliated with Bloogo, who promptly took the side of La Capitan.  Foiled again!!

However, despite AG Legacy's disappointment at not being able to finish off La Capitan himself this particular turn, Sky-Scraper emergency evac'd again to destroy Bloogo.  Legacy was excited!  The field was open for him to strike down the time traveling pirate wench and save Christopher!

Then Tempest's turn happened--and his electrical storm finished off La Capitan.  It was a sad day in the life of AG Legacy.

Alas, Christopher was not found in the Enclave of the Endlings.  At least, I don't think it was Christopher.  If it was, Tempest sort of...crisped him with lightning.

Heroes--America's Greatest Legacy, Sky-Scraper, Tempest, and Parse

Environment--Enclave of the Endlings

posts.name: metlarcturus
posts.cooked:
It was a slow day in the Freedom Tower. Megalopolis was quiet, its citizens seemingly safe (for now). But then, a call on the vid-monitor! Tachyon, who was manning the communications station while simultaneously running thirteen experiments, was shocked to see that the call originated from Baron Blade! What dastardly scheme was he hatching now?

"Ah, Tachyon." The baron looked like he hadn't slept in several days. "I realize that I'm not on the best of terms with the Freedom Five, but... I need someone to get this cursed woman off my mobile defense platform!" The camera panned to show Maria Helena sitting in the baron's throne control chair, her boots up on the console. She waved jauntily.

Dr. Stinson didn't want to do Blade any favors, but the possibility that Christopher was aboard the platfrom couldn't be ignored. She grabbed her intern, Unity, and Anthony Drake, who was helping Devra design a prototype Bard Bot, and made tracks for the baron's floating fortress. Along the way, the team encountered the Sentinels, who had heard that La Capitan was in the area.

Sneaking into the shielding station of the platform the heroes were set upon by wave after wave of Maria Helena's time-travelling crew. However, Tachyon and Mainstay held the line, giving the Argent Adept and Unity time to construct a veritable army of mechanical golems. With her crew defeated, La Capitan was cornered by a wave of Platform Bots and Raptor Bots swarming over her. Sadly, there was no sign of Christopher aboard the platform.

Baron Blade was grateful for the assist, and generously "allowed" the heroes to depart in peace. Back at Freedom Tower, however, Unity revealed that she had "accidentally" left several Raptor Bots aboard the platform, where they terrorized Blade's crew.

Team Leader Tachyon, Unity, the Argent Adept, and the Sentinels have defeated La Capitan aboard the Mobile Defense Platform!
